opportunities.name: Track a Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: Open Megabus 'Check my bus' > Track my bus, switch to Service Number search, enter the {service_number}, pick the matching route suggestion and click Find my bus.
steps: Click 'Check my bus' in the top nav
Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'
Select the matching route suggestion from the dropdown

opportunities.name: Book a Resy special event
opportunities.description: In a Resy city, open Special Events & Experiences, choose the {event}, set the {ticket_count}, pick the ticket tier or time slot and complete the reservation.
steps: Open Special Events & Experiences for the current city (event icon or 'See more')
Select the number of tickets from the ticket combobox
Click 'Book Now' for the ticket tier or click the time slot
In the Complete Your Reservation dialog, click 'Reserve Now'
